groups.title: Comment box
groups.note: While the comment box is open. Ctrl on Windows and Linux, ⌘ on a Mac. A picked hint is saved as the comment and the box closes. Hints after the 10th have no key.

rows.action: Show all hints with their keys (CC, VV: press twice)
Pick hint 1
Pick hint 2 (with text selected in the box: cut, as usual)
Pick hint 3 (the first press still copies)
Pick hint 4 (the first press still pastes)
Pick hint 5; the file list does not show or hide while the box is open
Pick hint 6
Pick hint 7
Pick hint 8
Pick hint 9
Pick hint 10
Save a comment asking to remove the selected passage

groups.title: Multi-line comments
groups.note: In Source, or the Source pane of Split.

rows.action: A line number: start picking lines for one comment
A line number while picking: add or remove that line (after Cancel, a picked line only brings the box back)
A line number while picking: add every line from the last clicked one to this one
Across line numbers while picking: add the lines (start on an unpicked line) or remove them (start on a picked one)
Leave line picking: hide the comment box and drop the lines
In the comment box while picking: leave line picking and drop the lines
Save the comment and leave line picking
Hide the comment box but keep the lines; click a line number to bring it back. On a touch screen Cancel also leaves line picking
Move the comment box
With the ⠿ grip focused: move the comment box; Shift takes a bigger step

groups.title: Review
groups.note: Markdown files only: mark the blocks you have read. Keys work when you are not typing and no box is open.

rows.action: Mark or unmark the block in the reading band, shown by a gray dashed ✓ beside it (under the pointer in pointer Focus mode); after marking, go to the next unreviewed block
Mark or unmark the whole section of that block
Next / previous unreviewed block
The lane beside a block: mark, unmark, or confirm a changed block (○)
The lane: mark or unmark every block between the last clicked lane and this one
The square beside a heading: mark or unmark the whole section
In the comment box: mark the whole blocks touched by the selection or the picked lines
Phone / touch: mark the block in the reading band and go to the next unreviewed one
The progress strip at a pane's right edge: scroll there (mouse only)
A pale green ✓ suggested from your reading time: accept it, marking the block reviewed
Review tab: mark every block with a pale green ✓ reviewed
Touch: the button at the bottom right, when blocks look read: mark them all reviewed (Undo in the message)

groups.title: Files
groups.note: The file list on the left. Keys work when a row has focus.

rows.action: Show or hide the file list (not while typing in a box or while the comment box is open)
Move between rows
Open or close a folder; go to its first file, or back to the parent folder
Open a file, or open or close a folder
Rename (Enter saves, Esc cancels)
A file or folder in the tree: rename it (Enter saves, Esc cancels)
Pick several files or folders (the open file joins the first pick). Delete, drag, or ⋯ on a picked row then acts on all of them; a plain click or Esc drops the picks
Delete the file or folder, or every picked one
More actions: new file or folder here, rename, move, download, delete
Filter files by name (see Searching files below)
A row onto a folder (or onto empty space for the top level): move it. Files or folders from your computer: import a copy
Open this list (not while typing in a box)
